Metadata.title: Spirit O Santa for Stores
Metadata.description: List gift items for local kids and get paid when they earn them.

HomePage.title: Spirit O Santa for Stores
HomePage.intro: List up to 50 gift items. Kids earn them with good deeds, and you get paid.

RegisterPage.title: List your store on Spirit O Santa
RegisterPage.intro: Local kids earn gifts with good deeds. Sign up, add up to 50 items, and bill us the agreed wholesale cost when an item is earned.
RegisterPage.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence works well.
RegisterPage.descriptionHint: What do you sell? Families will see this once you're approved.
RegisterPage.sentBody: We've sent a confirmation link. Confirm your email, then sign in to set up your items while we review your store.

StoreAgreement.title: Store discount and guarantee agreement
StoreAgreement.p1: You list items at your normal retail price. Each item's price in magic points equals its retail price in dollars.
StoreAgreement.p2: Spirit O Santa agrees a discount off retail with your store when we approve it. When a child's item is funded, you bill Spirit O Santa the agreed wholesale cost (retail price minus that discount).
StoreAgreement.p3: You guarantee listed items stay available at the listed price for the season, or you offer an equal or better substitute.
StoreAgreement.p4: Spirit O Santa keeps the difference between retail and wholesale to run the program.
StoreAgreement.p5: Spirit O Santa pays your invoices by check or another method outside the app. No bank details are stored in the app.
StoreAgreement.accept: I have read and accept the store discount and guarantee agreement.
